title: Trained on What Screen Readers Cannot Read: Accessibility Debt in the GUI Corpora Behind Computer-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.16107v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer-use agents learn to operate mobile interfaces from corpora of captured screens and accessibility trees. The same trees are what a screen reader consumes, so an agent trained on them inherits whatever labelling gaps the underlying applications carry. This paper measures one of those gaps, content-description coverage, in two Android corpora: Rico, collected in 2017, and AndroidControl, collected in 2024. Across 17,373,614 interface elements, 17.74% of the Rico elements that need a content description under our coding rule carry one, against 57.27% in AndroidControl. The difference of 39.5 percentage points holds under five alternative coding rules and when whole apps are resampled. It describes two datasets that also differ in app selection, capture method and platform version; it does not measure change over time. Input controls are the least labelled role in both corpora (2.20% and 27.21%, or 30.99% in AndroidControl if hint

translated_title: 在屏幕阅读器无法读取的内容上训练：计算机使用智能体背后 GUI 语料库中的无障碍债务
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体通过由截取屏幕和无障碍树组成的语料库来学习操作移动界面。这些无障碍树同时也是屏幕阅读器所消费的内容，因此基于它们训练的智能体会继承底层应用程序所固有的标注缺失问题。本文在两个 Android 语料库中测量了其中一个缺口——内容描述覆盖率：2017 年收集的 Rico 和 2024 年收集的 AndroidControl。在 17,373,614 个界面元素中，按照我们的编码规则，Rico 中需要内容描述的元素仅有 17.74% 带有内容描述，而 AndroidControl 中这一比例为 57.27%。这 39.5 个百分点的差距在五种替代编码规则下以及在对整个应用进行重采样时依然成立。该差距描述的是两个在应用选择、捕获方式和平台版本上均有差异的数据集；本文并未测量随时间推移的变化。输入控件在两个语料库中都是标注率最低的角色类型（分别为 2.20% 和 27.21%，若考虑提示文本，AndroidControl 中为 30.99%……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究首次测量了训练计算机使用智能体的 GUI 语料库中的无障碍债务，发现 Rico 与 AndroidControl 中需要内容描述的界面元素仅有 17.74% 与 57.27% 具备描述，意味着智能体是在屏幕阅读器无法读取的内容上学习的。
en_tdlr: This paper measures accessibility debt in the GUI corpora behind computer-use agents, showing that only 17.74% of Rico elements and 57.27% of AndroidControl elements that need content descriptions have them, meaning agents are trained on what screen readers cannot read.
